# Copilot instructions (datacluster-template)

Read `AGENTS.md` in the repository root first. It is the canonical Datacluster Template
agent guidance — the two tracks and their guides, GitOps deployment, encryption
requirements, repository layout, tooling, secret handling, cluster access, and
the pre-production testing sequence.

There are no Copilot-specific overrides. Record new guidance in `AGENTS.md`, not
here.
